title: The Rulebook
subtitle: AI regulation and governance for operators, boards and investors
description: Two hosts map the AI rules that reach ordinary businesses in late 2026: the global landscape, the EU AI Act after the Digital Omnibus, the American patchwork of federal enforcement and state laws, and governance that works for boards, management teams and private equity funds. Built from public sources; not legal advice.
author: Hana & Theo
